title: Missing-page illustration

location.extent: Complete local video; PNG is first-frame poster

slide_intent: Keep a service interruption understandable and human so an error does not abruptly break the brand experience.
strategic_value: The missing-ingredient illustration can make Sweetgreen’s error message feel related to its food-focused voice.
demonstration: A tablet among produce displays Sorry, this page cannot be found beside an outlined figure and a tall plant with a dotted missing area.
practical_value: Pair a plain error statement and recovery control with an illustration that acknowledges something is absent.

content_islands.name: Error screen
content_islands.spec: Place the illustration left of the message and highlighted recovery control on the tablet.

content_islands.name: Produce setting
content_islands.spec: Retain the wooden crates and vegetables surrounding the screen.

reference_purposes.Application: The brand illustration appears on a missing-page interface with a recovery action.
reference_purposes.Expression: The small character moves beneath a plant while the error message stays visible.
